subject: Covariance matrix as input /difference in estimates between Lavaan, LISREL and STATA

messages.author: d031878e1659da84
messages.subject: Covariance matrix as input /difference in estimates between Lavaan, LISREL and STATA
parts:
Hello,

We are preparing a module for teaching purposes where students receive the same input in Lisrel, STATA and Lavaan. We use a covariance matrix as input to show a procedure to correct for measurement error using single questions by introducing information of the measurement quality in the covariance matrix. We get different results in Lavaan  VS Lisrel/STATA In the first model (which is a simple regression) but in the second we get all coefficients the same, I think this result is very strange and want to check if we are doing something wrong. Maybe the model is so simple that we are forgetting a detail but so far I can see what is it.

I read in a discussion that different results may appear across versions of LISREL, I am using version 8.72 and STATA 12.

Please find enclosed the inputs in the three programs.

Many thanks.

Best,

Diana Zavala Rojas
ESS Researcher
Research and Expertise Centre for Survey Methodology

messages.subject: Re: Covariance matrix as input /difference in estimates between Lavaan, LISREL and STATA
parts:
It would appear this is due to a small typo in the correlation matrix:

lower.corrected<- '
.710
0.395 .643
0.268 0.333 .604
0.310 0.160 0.114 .605
0.112 0.07 0.018 0.094 .682
0.163 0.227 0.174 0.064 0.009 .624'

The 0.227 in the last row should be 0.277. After fixing this, the
results are identical.

Yves.
